The house DOI suffix hmtc.manual.food-contact-consumer-goods-and-kitchenware is reserved for deposit. cert_doi stays empty until that deposit. Method edition is at /program/method.

versions.label: Manual v1
versions.summary: First Category 23 Program Manual. Thirty live standards. Numeric ceilings are the values on those standards. Species with no separate number are capped at the parent total and tested on every lot. Metal safety only.
